requirements: Grim Tales starts after Witch's House. Later boosts: Farming 45, Herblore 52, Thieving 58, Agility 59, Woodcutting 71. Start does not prematurely require all five skills.
Path of Glouphrie starts after The Eyes of Glouphrie, Waterfall Quest and Tree Gnome Village. Pinned level gates: Strength 60, Slayer 56, Thieving 56, Ranged 47, Agility 45, observed non-boostable.

Grim: two tarromin potion (unf), a seed dibber, a watered can, leather gloves, axe and combat gear. Path: mith grapple plus crossbow, ample space for disks, food and recommended ear protection. GE stage prices are estimates.

observations.grim_tales: Sylas in Taverley needs Grimgnash's feather and Rupert's helmet. Griffin story and stolen feather, tower crumbling wall, Rupert's beard, Miazrqa's pendant, witch's basement music, two shrink-me-quick potions, mouse-sized nail-wall maze and return, bean planting, Glod battle, remaining potion on beanstalk, woodcutting, return to Sylas. The mix stage includes two 6-XP Herblore actions.
observations.grim_rewards: 1 quest point; 60,000 Woodcutting, 25,000 Agility, 25,000 Thieving, 15,000 Herblore, 10,000 Farming, 5,000 Hitpoints XP; Dwarven helmet; Glod eligible for Nightmare Zone.
observations.path_of_glouphrie: King Bolren and Dumpling, Golrie's dungeon cell, crystal disks/monoliths, chime seed, strongroom key, Yewnock machine and Bolrie's three diary cutscenes, Gianne Jr., grapple crossing from Castle Wars bank, Longramble, Incomitatus and Hazelmere, poisoned sewer and the Warped Depths ladder network, three warped terrorbirds, heavy-door scripted escape and final Hazelmere conversation.
observations.path_rewards: 2 quest points; four separately retained skill-fixed lamps offering 20,000 Slayer, 5,000 Thieving, 30,000 Strength and 5,000 Magic XP. Incomitatus spirit tree unlocks upon chime use; access to Poison Waste Dungeon and warped creature Slayer unlocks are modeled.
observations.travel: All new interior and dungeon links have directed reverse edges. Grim connects to the existing Taverley, White Wolf Mountain and Mind Altar nodes; Path connects to Tree Gnome Village, Gnome Stronghold, Castle Wars balloon and Hazelmere. Quest cutscene transitions move the player from one waypoint to another.
